51 weeks = 357 days.  
357 days + 5 days = 362 days.  
1460 is a leap year (divisible by 4, pre-Gregorian but Julian rule applies for 1460).  
From 1460-05-07 add 362 days:  
May has 31 days, so days remaining in May after 7th: 24 → total so far 24.  
June 30 → total 54.  
July 31 → total 85.  
August 31 → total 116.  
September 30 → total 146.  
October 31 → total 177.  
November 30 → total 207.  
December 31 → total 238.  
Remaining days: 362 - 238 = 124 days into 1461.  
1461 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4).  
January 31 → total 269 (238+31).  
February 28 → total 297.  
March 31 → total 328.  
April 30 → total 358.  
Remaining: 362 - 358 = 4 days into May → May 4, 1461.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1461-05-04
